subject: Personnel credentialing digest for SIG review
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@compliancetools.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brightline Audit Team <audit@brightline.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: personnel screening & training samples

Hi Logan,

Brightline is conducting the SIG/SOC2 crosswalk for Redwood and we have a few narrow asks focused on personnel controls for the reviewer. Can you provide the following artifacts (redacted where required) covering the last 12 months:

- Onboarding ledger extract (user id, role, start date, baseline access group) — CSV preferred.
- Representative background check reports (redacted PII; we only need outcome + check type + verification date).
- Training completion export for security awareness and data handling (timestamp + module id + pass/fail).
- Offboarding proof for employees who left in the last 6 months (access removal timestamp + deprovision ticket ref).

Scope note: we only need a sample set of records (20–30 employees) for the SIG evidentiary review; auditors may request follow-up if any gaps appear. Our timeline is tight — preliminary sample by Wednesday 6/24 and the final bundle by 6/28.

Also confirm how you handle PII redaction and whether there is an attestable process owner for each dataset. If you prefer a secure transfer (SFTP or shared Drive with restricted link), let us know.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Compliance Analyst
ComplianceTools.io

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@compliancetools.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: personnel screening & training samples

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. We can provide a compact evidence bundle that meets this scope. Quick plan below: 

1) Sample sizing and redaction approach- We'll provide a 25-record sample for onboarding and training exports. Background check PDFs will be redacted by Security (PII removed; candidate IDs replaced with hashed IDs). Offboarding events will include the ticket ref and timestamp; we will not include personal contact info.

2) Files we will attach (prelim by 6/24):
- onboarding-log-sample-2028Q2.csv (CSV: hashed_user_id, role, start_date, access_group)
- bg-check-sample-redacted.pdf (3 redacted sample reports)
- training-completion-snapshot-202806.xlsx (export: hashed_user_id, module, completed_at, status)

3) Data owner and attestations- Karthik (cc'd) is the people-controls owner and will provide an attestation statement for process and retention windows; Marissa is handling the exports and redactions.

4) Transfer method- We will upload to a restricted Drive folder (link + access for your audit address) and provide a checksum for each file. If you require SFTP, we can arrange.

I'll get the preliminary bundle to you by EOD Tuesday (6/24). Full packet, including attestation, by 6/28. Let me know if you need a different record set (e.g., only employees with prod access).

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@compliancetools.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brightline Audit Team <audit@brightline.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: personnel screening & training samples

Logan — perfect, that approach works. A couple of clarifications: 

- Please prefer hashed_user_id using SHA256 and include the salt method in a short metadata file (we do not need the salt itself).
- For background checks we only need the verification outcome (clear / exception) and the verification date; a single sample of each check type you run (criminal, employment verification, identity) is sufficient.
- Offboarding: limit to employees who had access to production systems.
- Attestation: a signed PDF from Karthik confirming the render and retention policy is ideal.

For transfer, Drive is fine — please share via a restricted link and add audit@brightline.com. We will confirm receipt and checksum.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@compliancetools.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Personnel credentialing digest — preliminary bundle uploaded

Alex — uploading the preliminary bundle now. Summary below and attachments included.

Attachments (attached to this message and uploaded to Drive):
- onboarding-log-sample-2028Q2.csv (25 rows; fields: hashed_user_id, role, start_date, access_group)
- bg-check-sample-redacted.pdf (3 sample reports; outcome + check_type + verification_date visible; all PII redacted)
- training-completion-snapshot-202806.xlsx (25 rows; module id, completed_at, status)
- metadata-readme.txt (notes on hashing method and retention windows)

Drive link (restricted, added audit@brightline.com): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-personnel-evidence
Checksums: onboarding-log-sample-2028Q2.csv: e3b0c442..., bg-check-sample-redacted.pdf: 9f86d081...

Karthik will follow up with a signed attestation PDF by 6/28 confirming process ownership and retention policy. If the auditor needs additional sampling (e.g., non-prod contractors), let us know and we will expand the extract.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
